com.flexganttfx.view.graphics.renderer.WeekendCalendarActivityRenderer<A>
public class WeekendCalendarActivityRenderer<A extends WeekendCalendarActivity> extends CalendarActivityRenderer<A>
Specialized calendar activity renderer for weekend intervals. It binds its fill and opacity to the graphics view's weekend styling properties and omits a visible stroke.
